7647.title: Pi confirmation validation synthesizes cancellation
7647.rootCauseOneLine: The shared Pi UI schema rejects messages above 8192 code units; the coordinator immediately responds cancelled before creating an interaction, which Pi maps to false.
7647.proposedFix: Preserve large confirmation details through the shared request and payload contract, and distinguish bridge validation failures from user refusal. No autopilot fix: schema/protocol changes exceed the simple-fix safety gate.
7647.caveats: Direct bridge-level reproduction repeated in two clean trusted checkouts. Final Pi boolean mapping was source-inspected, not executed in a model session. Test and diagnostic output are inline under reports repository policy.
